We wish to report that company has setting up the 1000 TPD Single Super Phosphate/ Granular Single Super Phosphate (SSP/GSSP) plant and any other Manufacturing activities relating to fertilizer at Dhule, Maharashtra along with DAP/ NPK integrated Plant including Phosphoric Acid and Sulphuric Acid plant. '.
